transparency.cleanupFinding: Source is RGBA but fully opaque. Derived cleanup removes baked checkerboard/fake transparency while preserving original 1408x768 layout.

functionalSurfaceBoundary.notes: Functional-surface candidate flags are preserved as planning metadata only. H5.48 does not perform functional slot mapping, define gameplay sorting logic, or wire runtime visuals.

cleanupMethod.summary: Derived-only checkerboard cleanup preserving the original sheet layout.
cleanupMethod.backgroundRemovalPolicy: Remove edge-connected strict-neutral checker/grid pixels for all regions; remove strict-neutral interior checker pixels for glass/liquid/potion-style regions; apply broadened neutral checker removal only inside high-risk glow/smoke/spill/sparkle regions to reduce visible gray checker contamination without treating FX as final-approved.
cleanupMethod.riskPolicy: Glows, smoke, spills, liquid edges, glass edges, fire, sparkles, baked labels, and small badge details are flagged for review rather than treated as automatically approved.
